statement: When a procedure lists one set of files in two steps, the copies drift. A procedure named the files whose changes needed re-checking in two separate steps. The two lists came from different sources and diverged, so one step would have skipped files the other covered. Neither list was wrong on its own terms; the defect was that nothing tied them together. Rules: when one set is listed in two places, derive both from one definition, or check mechanically that both name the same files.
